## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
library(bigrquery)
library(httr)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
```

```{r}

apikey <- "95A548D2-108A-39D9-AAFA-ABC87DFAE9FD"

# Base endpoint
base_url <- "https://quickstats.nass.usda.gov/api/api_GET/"

```


```{r}
states <- state.abb        # "AL", "AK", ..., "WY"
years  <- 2000:2020        # adjust as needed

# Prepare an empty data.frame
all_corn_county <- data.frame()

for (st in states) {
  for (yr in years) {
    message("Fetching ", st, " ", yr)
    # build the URL (URLencode the spaces)
    url <- paste0(
      base_url,
      "?key=",        apikey,
      "&commodity_desc=CORN",
      "&statisticcat_desc=", URLencode("AREA HARVESTED"),
      "&unit_desc=ACRES",
      "&agg_level_desc=COUNTY",
      "&freq_desc=ANNUAL",
      "&state_alpha=",  st,
      "&year=",         yr,
      "&format=CSV"
    )
    # pull and rbind
    df <- read_csv(url, show_col_types = FALSE)
    all_corn_county <- rbind(all_corn_county, df)
  }
}

# quick check
str(all_corn_county)
```
